name: ZOE_OL_CLIENT_EVENTS
description: This table stores the events occured in Fusion CRM for Microsoft outlook clients connected to Fusion server.

columns.name: CLIENT_EVENT_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for this client.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the event as reported by the client.

columns.name: EVENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the event as reported by the client.

columns.name: EVENT_REPORTED_ON
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of this event as reported by the client.

columns.name: CLIENT_ID
columns.description: The client which reported this event. It is cross refernced against CLIENT_ID from ZOE_OL_SYNCED_CLIENTS table.

columns.name: SYNC_SIZE
columns.description: Indicates the amount of data transfered.

columns.name: SYNC_DURATION
columns.description: Time taken for the sync.

columns.name: SYNCED_DOWN_RECORD_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates the number of records synced down.

columns.name: SYNCED_UP_RECORD_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates the number of records synced up.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_ID
columns.description: Reference to the log file received from client.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RECORDS_PROCESSED
columns.description: Number of records processed.

columns.name: SYNC_CONFIRMATIONS
columns.description: Indicates the number of confirmations during sync

columns.name: SYNC_DUPLICATES
columns.description: Indicates the number of duplicates during sync

columns.name: SYNC_ISSUES
columns.description: Indicates the number of issues during sync

columns.name: SYNC_CONFLICTS
columns.description: Indicates the number of conflicts during sync

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_01
columns.description: New Attribute 01

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_02
columns.description: New Attribute 02
